purpose: A full-screen picture viewer for React apps that works like a phone's photo app: swipe, pinch and double-tap zoom, drag, keys, wheel and full screen, with the picture shown at once and sharpened when its full file arrives.
namedChanges: V1: `LightboxItem` gains two optional fields after `fallback`: `thumbSrc` and `fileUri` (src/types.ts)
V2: `LightboxWords` and `defaultWords` gain `fullScreen` ("Full screen") and `exitFullScreen` ("Leave full screen") (src/types.ts, src/lightboxCore.ts)

the port: `LightboxViewer.vue` is the React function component `PictureViewer` (`ref` to state with a ref kept in step, `computed` to expressions, `watch(item, startLoad, { immediate })` to a layout effect on the shown index and the item's src, fallback and fileUri, `onMounted`/`onBeforeUnmount` to one effect with cleanup, Teleport to body to `createPortal` into `document.body`, the wheel listener native and non-passive); the `<style scoped>` block is `src/pictureViewer.css`, copied by script; handler bodies, numbers, thresholds and order are the source's
A1 full screen: a button after the zoom buttons (drawn only when `document.fullscreenEnabled`), the key `f`, and leaving the viewer exits full screen
A2 neighbours load first: when the shown picture is ready, the picture before and the one after are loaded (through `resolveSrc`, else `new Image().src`), never more, each once

A3 shown at once: `thumbSrc` is drawn at once (`ilb-img ilb-img-thumb`) with no loading cue, replaced when `src` loads, kept behind the failed message when it fails; css `.ilb-img-pending` for the unseen real picture
A4 signed sources: `resolveSrc` answers the file to load; a rejection is a failed load with the same fallback rule
A5 tap shows and hides the controls: a single tap on the picture after `DOUBLE_TAP_TIME` toggles `ilb-chrome-hidden` on the dialog (css `visibility: hidden`); any key shows them again

usePictureViewer: `{ open(items, index), viewer }`, closing restores focus to the element that had it when `open` was called; it stands in for the three Vue wrappers (ImageLightbox, LightboxScope, ProseImg), which are not ported

host.replaces: the plain `item.src` load: `shownSrc.value = item.value.src` in `startLoad`, web-units/image-lightbox/src/LightboxViewer.vue:41 (optional; without it `item.src` is used)
